decision_rule.caveat: GAR and PCBAS anchors are defined by different annotation schemes; this is a bridge, not an equivalence test
decision_rule.consistent: GAR noball pass agreement within 5 points of PCBAS: no evidence of a 2022->2023/24 cohort penalty in player-only team attribution; PCBAS team-head training is not prioritized
decision_rule.gap: GAR noball pass agreement more than 5 points above PCBAS: cohort/visibility gap; an H/A-only PCBAS auxiliary fine-tune becomes the recommended training experiment

exposure: GAR TEST was scored once by gar_deployment_eval_v2 (clean/v2). No model was selected on it; this adds a new input view only.
metrics: live-frame team agreement (silver H/A frames; D/X wrong)
predicted-D rate on silver live frames
PCBAS-like anchor agreement at controlled touch-run end frames: BC->drive, PA->pass, CR->cross, SH->shot
mode: phase_avg (six GAR sampling phases, frozen decoder)
parity: clean original_full and calibrated phase_avg per-game spell/macro F1 must equal the saved gar_deployment_eval_v2 TEST values within 1e-9 before any noball readout
primary: equal-game noball pass-anchor agreement of original_full, compared descriptively with PCBAS 0.688; and clean-minus-noball spell F1 with paired whole-game bootstrap
question: On GAR TEST, how much does removing every ball observation cost the exact adopted package, and is PCBAS player-only pass agreement consistent with GAR under the same regime?

views.noball: all ball coordinates NaN and ball_observed False; players, masks, periods and timestamps unchanged
